version.changelog:
Currency Converter Pro v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Supports real-time exchange rates for 150+ currencies.
- Enables batch conversion, cross-currency comparison, and historical rate queries.
- No API Key required; uses free, frequently updated data from open.er-api.com.
- Covers major currencies including CNY, USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, and more.

Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: currency-converter-pro
Version: 1.0.0

The skill provides legitimate currency conversion functionality using a public API (open.er-api.com). The Python script (scripts/currency.py) and documentation (SKILL.md) are well-structured, lack any evidence of data exfiltration, backdoors, or prompt injection, and handle inputs safely via standard type conversions.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and requirements are coherent with a currency-conversion utility: it fetches rates from open.er-api.com, needs no credentials or installs, and does not access unrelated system data.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do exactly what it claims: run a small Python script that queries open.er-api.com for exchange rates. It requires outbound network access to that provider but no credentials. Before installing, consider: (1) outbound queries (your conversion requests and amounts) will be sent to open.er-api.com — avoid sending any sensitive personal data in queries; (2) verify you trust the provider and that your environment permits TLS network calls; (3) the script includes an unused subprocess import (harmless but a sign of minor sloppy code). If you need an offline or private solution, do not install — otherwise this skill is consistent and proportionate.
